about: Golden set for word readings and headline glosses, checked by tests/test_golden_glosses.py
against the pinned dictionary data. Expected values are what a learner textbook gives,
not what the code happens to output.
Entries: all new-HSK 1-2 headwords, tricky polyphones above HSK 2 (checks: polyphone),
HSK 1-2 component characters, and non-words that segmentation produces (expect: not_a_word).
pinyin: tone marks, syllables space-separated; compared ignoring case, spaces and apostrophes.
Citation tones for yi/bu (no tone sandhi); neutral tones as in textbooks; erhua as -r.
pinyin_alt: other readings a textbook also accepts. accept: the headline must contain one of
these keywords (case-insensitive, whole word, plural/-ed/-ing endings allowed).
checks: ui-tone / iu-tone (tone-mark placement), no-tag (no register tag in the headline).
not_a_word: the resolver must not glue per-character glosses ('A + B').
xfail: currently wrong, with the branch expected to fix it (B6 glue words, B7 wrong reading,
B8 wrong sense with the right reading). The test marks these xfail(strict=True), so a fix
makes the run fail until the xfail field is removed here. xfail_note: why an entry was
moved on to a later branch.

accept: first month of the lunar year

entries.xfail_note: not in CC-CEDICT; the HSK list's own pinyin and gloss are machine junk ('yīhuǐr5', 'Take a short while'), so it needs a curated gloss

accept: what one has seen and heard
